source_note: Base hourly charges from five AGS client invoice schedules, with 54 included staff rows. Limited historical sample; role coverage varies and most roles have one observed rate. Overtime and other charges are excluded.

roles.label: Medical billing support
roles.note: Medical Billing Specialist: 7 staff rows across 2 invoices; scope and experience differ by engagement.

roles.label: Verification of benefits (VOB)
roles.note: VOB Specialist: 26 staff rows in 1 invoice; one observed rate, not a market range.

roles.label: Medical collections support
roles.note: Medical Collections Specialist: 12 staff rows in 1 invoice; does not price every A/R or denial workflow.

roles.label: Authorization and appeal resolution
roles.note: Combined Authorization and Appeal Resolution Specialist: 4 staff rows in 1 invoice; confirm your task mix.

roles.label: Appointment setting
roles.note: Appointment Setter: 2 staff rows in 1 invoice; does not establish a full medical receptionist rate.

roles.label: Customer service support
roles.note: Customer Service Representative: 3 staff rows across 2 invoices; confirm healthcare-specific requirements.

roles.label: Virtual medical receptionist
roles.note: Receptionist scope extends beyond appointment setting; request a role-specific quote.

roles.label: Medical coding
roles.note: The reviewed invoices do not establish a coding rate; credentials and scope need a quote.

roles.label: Other or specialized role
roles.note: Describe your required work, experience and coverage in the follow-up discussion.
